blocks.text: 周四下午，Demis Hassabis 庆祝了 Google AI 事业的一个里程碑：Gemini 4 Carbon——一款目前仅向网络防御人员开放的新大语言模型——登顶 Artificial Analysis 智能指数。此前新模型发布接连延期，外界越来越觉得这家公司正在掉出前沿阵营，而早期迹象显示，Carbon 标志着 Google 重回正轨。对 Alphabet 的首席科学家来说，这消息想必像是一场正名。

blocks.text: 到现在，大多数人已经熟悉谷歌与互联网之间那笔不断变化的交易。过去，发布者允许谷歌抓取自己的页面，谷歌则回馈以海量流量。谷歌从搜索结果中嵌入的广告里赚得盆满钵满，发布者则从访问其页面的人那里获得较少的收益。（去年，美国政府在一桩反垄断诉讼中胜诉，认定谷歌利用自身地位在广告市场建立了非法垄断，但按美国的一贯做法，该公司的垄断力量几乎原封不动地保留了下来。）

blocks.text: Reddit一直是谷歌所能输送流量的最大受益者之一。随着网络上大量内容被粗制滥造的东西淹没，真人撰写的对话变得更有价值，谷歌也开始在搜索结果中突出论坛讨论。Reddit的搜索流量随之激增；在该公司姗姗来迟地关闭了论坛对无休止抓取其内容的机器人的访问之后，据报道谷歌每年支付6000万美元来获得这些数据的授权。

blocks.text: 但到2022年ChatGPT成为爆款时，谷歌已经花了很多年时间努力让用户在自己的页面上停留更久。这个最初作为通往更广阔网络的跳板，随着时间推移变成了一个可以直接在搜索结果页上找到答案的地方。发布者再也无法享有像“超级碗几点开始”这样利润丰厚的套利机会；谷歌会自己回答你的问题。这或许在某种程度上是谷歌的贪婪，但也是对用户需求的明确回应。

blocks.text: 我第一次使用ChatGPT时，在我看来很明显，它在各种谷歌搜索上的答案都明显更好。谷歌迟早必须做出回应，而它也确实回应了，推出了AI概览和AI模式。概览是显示在传统搜索顶部的那种方框；AI模式则是一个独立界面，可以从概览进入。无论如何，一年前谷歌高管曾表示，概览的变现效果与传统搜索大致相当；今天这条新闻之所以引起这么多人注意，一个原因就是它暗示AI模式——显然代表着许多高价值品类中搜索的未来——的变现效果并非如此。

blocks.text: On Thursday afternoon, Demis Hassabis celebrated a milestone for Google’s AI efforts: Gemini 4 Carbon, a new large language model that is currently available only to cyber defenders, topped Artificial Analysis’ Intelligence Index. After a series of delays in new model releases and a growing perception that the company is falling off the frontier, early signs suggest that Carbon marks a return to form. For Alphabet’s chief scientist, the news surely felt like a vindication.

blocks.text: Investors, however, are much less certain. On the same day, Google’s parent company had its worst day in history as a public company. Alphabet’s stock fell 12.6 percent, erasing around $500 billion in market value. The loss marked the second-biggest stock market plunge ever, following Nvidia’s $593 billion slide in January 2025. And it was Google’s biggest one-day decline since the great financial crisis.

And it reported free cash flow of negative $9 billion — an acceleration of a decline that began the previous quarter.

blocks.text: Then, a few hours later, Reddit reported its own earnings for the quarter — and saw its own stock drop 15 percent. The company noted that its traffic from search had fallen meaningfully, and that by the fourth quarter daily users might decline by a low double-digit percentage. As a result, Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said in a shareholder letter, the company would increasingly push users to log in to use the site. After decades of letting people (and bots) browse the site for free, they would now have to create accounts.

blocks.text: By now most of you are familiar with the changing bargain Google has made with the internet. In the old days, publishers let Google index their pages, and Google sent them a flood of traffic in return. Google profited hugely from the ads it embedded in search results, and publishers enjoyed smaller profits from the people who visited their pages. (Last year the US government won an antitrust lawsuit finding that Google had used its position to create an illegal monopoly in the ad market, but in the American fashion, the company’s monopoly power was left almost entirely intact.)

blocks.text: The first time I used ChatGPT, it seemed obvious to me that the answers improved significantly on a wide variety of Google searches. Google was always going to have to respond, and it did, with AI Overviews and AI Mode. Overviews are those boxes that show up on top of traditional search; AI Mode is a separate interface that you can access from the overviews. In any case, a year ago Google executives were saying that overviews monetized about as well as traditional search; one reason so many took notice of today’s news is the suggestion that AI Mode — which clearly seems to represent the future of search across many valuable categories — did not.

But U.S. daily users fell again, to 50.7 million from 53.2 million in the second quarter. That marked a second straight decline: in July, a much smaller dip from 53.5 million to 53.2 million helped send the stock down about 22 percent in a day. On that quarter's call, Huffman said AI Overviews had not yet been as good for Reddit as the traditional ten blue links. Weeks earlier, the Wall Street Journal reported that Reddit had discussed cutting off Google's AI access to its content as the two companies negotiated a renewal of their licensing deal.

inlines.text: The decline of the computer science major

blocks.text: What happened: The nonprofit National Student Clearinghouse released preliminary fall enrollment data on Thursday, and it confirmed a trend that’s accelerating — the number of students choosing computer science is still shrinking, and faster than before.

inlines.text: on Thursday, and it confirmed a trend that’s accelerating — the number of students choosing computer science is still shrinking, and faster than before.

blocks.text: Computer science programs saw double-digit decreases across four-year, two-year, and graduate institutions, even as total enrollment held steady. The rate of decline at four-year colleges picked up from about 7 percent last fall (when CS enrollment fell for the first time in roughly 20 years) to 12.4 percent this fall.
